source_note: Exact pages 6–7 from Melanie Cusato case 245caa8c… (form-feed + right-aligned page numbers + HH:MM:SS gutters). Trailing page-8 header included so page 7 closes cleanly. No synthetic lines.

entries.speaker: MR. MCGRATH
entries.text: Q. Do you know what I'm talking about when I say the phrase "Jonelle Blaze"?

entries.speaker: THE WITNESS
entries.text: A. Yes.

entries.speaker: MR. MCGRATH
entries.text: Q. What do I mean?

entries.speaker: THE WITNESS
entries.text: A. Video game tag.

entries.speaker: MR. MCGRATH
entries.text: Q. Okay. Anywhere else?

entries.speaker: THE WITNESS
entries.text: A. Not that I can recall.

entries.speaker: MR. MCGRATH
entries.text: Q. And where does the word "Blaze" come from in your life?

entries.speaker: THE WITNESS
entries.text: A. My husband's like, I guess, stage name.

entries.speaker: MR. MCGRATH
entries.text: Q. And stage name, what, is he a performer? Where does that come from?

entries.speaker: MS. MARINER
entries.text: MS. MARINER: Objection. Ambiguous.

entries.speaker: THE WITNESS
entries.text: A. I guess he was a performer, I guess.

entries.speaker: MR. MCGRATH
entries.text: Q. (By Mr. McGrath) What did he do?

entries.speaker: THE WITNESS
entries.text: A. He makes music.

entries.speaker: MR. MCGRATH
entries.text: Q. If I could direct your attention to some of the documents we've put in front of you. I'm not going to go through these right now, I just want to identify them for the record. If you could take a look at what's been marked as Exhibit Number 1, which should be at the top of your pile there, have you seen that document before?

entries.speaker: THE WITNESS
entries.text: A. No. No.

entries.speaker: MR. MCGRATH
entries.text: Q. I will represent to you that's your notice of your deposition for today. That's the formal paper that brought us here today. We just marked that for the record. If I could direct your attention now to the second document which is marked as Exhibit Number 2, again, not going to go through it right now, but I just want to get this out of the way because we'll be referring to it later. Have you seen Exhibit Number 2 before?

entries.speaker: THE WITNESS
entries.text: A. Yes. Yes.

entries.speaker: MR. MCGRATH
entries.text: Q. And can you tell us what Exhibit Number 2 is?

entries.speaker: THE WITNESS
entries.text: A. It says, "Complaint for Damages."

entries.speaker: MR. MCGRATH
entries.text: Q. So do you understand that to be the complaint that started the lawsuit we're here for?

entries.speaker: THE WITNESS
entries.text: A. I believe so.

entries.speaker: MR. MCGRATH
entries.text: Q. And now if I can -- again, just to get it out of the way, if I can direct your attention to Exhibit Number 3, which is in front of you, have you seen this document before?

entries.speaker: THE WITNESS
entries.text: A. No -- wait. (Document reviewed.) Oh, yes. Yes.

entries.speaker: MR. MCGRATH
entries.text: Q. Can you tell us what Exhibit Number 3 is?

entries.speaker: MS. MARINER
entries.text: MS. MARINER: I'm sorry. I didn't
